messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for the observability work next sprint. Focus areas: dashboards (overview/cost/errors), tracing hooks for customer-owned tracing, finer-grained cost breakdowns, and per-route error analytics. A few enterprise customers are pushing for cost per-route + per-model. What do we consider MUST vs CAN for beta?
sam: My take: MUST = cost breakdown per model/route, error heatmap per-route, simple overview dashboard (latency, throughput, cost). CAN = full tracing sampling UI + advanced query builder.
andre: Agree with sam. Operational constraints: dashboard queries need caching & async refreshs, traces should be sampled (1% default) to keep storage reasonable. Also need rollout checklist for private deployments (KMS integration + audit logs).
jess: UX note — start with 3 compact dashboards: Overview, Cost, Errors. For Errors keep the card to top 5 routes + quick link to traces. Avoid building a massive query console in beta.
elaine: Good. Drafting launch criteria below — want to confirm these are sufficient for a small but shippable beta to a handful of customers:
```
LAUNCH_CRITERIA: beta-v0.1
- Overview dashboard (global latency, qps, error rate)
- Cost breakdown: per-model, per-route, and 7/30d delta
- Error analytics: per-route counts, top 5 traces/example stack traces
- Tracing hook: server-side lightweight span injection + 1% sampled UI view
- Retention: metrics/aggregates 90d, traces 30d (sampled)
- Default trace sampling: 1% (configurable per-customer)
- Dashboard query p95 < 500ms (with caching)
- Rollout: canary 10% customers -> 50% -> 100% with auto-fallback to cached panels
- Compliance: EU customers must have telemetry consent toggle + private deploy controls
```
sam: Add two ops items: circuit-breaker for dashboard queries and automated regression alerts (cost spike, error spike). Also need a fallback model variant when a primary model is offline.
jess: For demos we need mocked datasets and CSV export on each dashboard card. Also short tooltips explaining what "cost per route" means.
andre: Implementation notes: we can hit all items if we throttle trace ingest and rely on pre-aggregated counters for dashboards. Private deployment GA should lag hosted by one quarter because of KMS/audit validation.
product-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://internal.redwood/deploy/obs-beta-v0.1 (canary: 10%) :white_check_mark:
elaine: Action items (owners) — please ack: 1) Product spec doc with acceptance tests -> @sam (prod/eng) 2) Dashboard mockups + tooltips -> @jess 3) Trace sampling + retention config -> @andre 4) Regression alerts rules + alerts runbook -> @sam 5) EU telemetry consent + privacy checklist -> @elaine 6) Demo data + CSV export -> @jess
sam: Ack. I'll draft the acceptance tests by EOD tomorrow.
jess: Ack. Will hand off mockups by Tue.
andre: Ack. I'll put up a tech design doc and cost estimate by Wed.
elaine: Thanks everyone — we'll review progress in Friday sync. If any blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
